name: nl.vogelaargroep/mailing
title: Vogelaar Mailing
description: Plan a direct mail campaign in the Netherlands: products, exact prices incl. postage, ordering.

tools.name: list-mailing-products
tools.description: Lists the direct mail products Vogelaar sells online (card/selfmailer, mailing in envelope, brochure in film): a short explanation, the print runs, a price indication per print run and the link to the online configurator. Prices are public webshop prices in EUR excl. VAT, including printing, addressing, processing and PostNL postage, for the default composition with Dutch addresses.

tools.name: get-mailing-product
tools.description: Returns one mailing product with all its steps and choices (format, paper, fold, envelope, ...), an explanation per step, the default selection, the PostNL delivery speeds and, for a mailing in envelope, the items that can go in the envelope.

tools.name: calculate-mailing-price
tools.description: Calculates the exact price of a mailing composition: one total for printing, addressing, processing and PostNL postage (public webshop prices, EUR excl. VAT), with the expected delivery days per speed, the weight and the postal format. When a combination is not possible, valid is false and problems explains why. The price is the same as in the configurator on shop.vogelaargroep.nl.

quantity.description: Number of addresses (pieces), including addresses abroad.

selection.description: Choice per step as {"step key": "choice key"} (the step and choice keys of the product). Steps you leave out get their default.

items.description: Mailing in envelope only: 1 to 4 items in the envelope, each {"product": item slug, "selection": {...}} (the items of the product). Default: one flyer.

inserts.description: Brochure in film only: 0 to 3 inserts, each {"product": insert slug, "selection": {...}}.

foreign_europe.description: How many of the addresses are abroad within Europe. When left out, foreign postage is not included.

foreign_row.description: How many of the addresses are abroad outside Europe.

supplied.description: Card or brochure in film: the customer supplies the printed card or brochure (we address or seal it).

own_envelope.description: Mailing in envelope: the customer supplies the envelopes.

tools.name: create-mailing-order
tools.description: Prepares an order in the Vogelaar webshop for a mailing composition and returns a personal link. On that page the customer uploads the print file and address file (now or later), enters company and contact details and pays with iDEAL, or logs in to order on account. Nothing is ordered or paid until the customer completes that page.

selection.description: Choice per step as {"step key": "choice key"} (the step and choice keys of the product). Steps you leave out get their default.

items.description: Mailing in envelope only: 1 to 4 items in the envelope, each {"product": item slug, "selection": {...}} (the items of the product). Default: one flyer.

tools.name: request-mailing-quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request to Vogelaar sales for work the webshop does not cover: large or recurring mailings, periodicals, personalised letters, fulfilment, special formats or advice. It creates a lead with the given name, e-mail address and message; a Vogelaar account manager contacts the person, usually within one working day.

name.description: Full name of the person asking.

message.description: What they want to send: product, print run, timing, wishes and any calculated price.
